thread:
lee: Need a compact battlecard for field this week: one page + 3 SDR hooks + routing rules. Focus: economics, migration flexibility, reliability.
tara: Keep language tight. No more than 6 bullets. SDRs want snappy lines.
nate: Proposed hooks: 
- "Stop surprise bills: reserved pools + per-route cost visibility."
- "One API, any deployment: devs ship once."
- "Fallbacks keep apps serving, not failing."
sasha: Add two discovery prompts for SDRs: "How predictable is your monthly inference spend?" and "Do you maintain separate infra for dev vs prod models?"
lee: Draft rebuttals quick: 
- Autoscale = variable cost -> we offer reserved capacity + burst controls.
- Self-hosted = isolation -> we support on-prem/VPC with same control plane.
- Retries = resilience -> retries add tail latency; policy routing + KV cache lowers tail.
tara: Bench blurb: "Typical customers see ~20% cost reduction after batching/caching (sample: mixed chat at 1k req/s)." label as typical.
nate: Routing rules for inbound: cost/pricing -> #sales-inbound; compliance/SLA/on-prem -> #ae-enterprise; benchmarks/RFPs -> #field-research.
sasha: I'll design a tiny visual: three boxes (client -> router -> model variants + fallback).
ops-bot: Uploaded draft: https://redwood.company/drive/marketing/ops-battlecard-v1 (auto-upload).
lee: Great. Tara run SDR roleplay tomorrow and report edits. Aim to publish PDF to #sales by EOD Fri.
